title: Warm Crispy German Pork Skillet
description: A light and flavorful German dish featuring pork, shallots, and a hint of funk, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This recipe is FODMAP-friendly and easy to make.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the pork to the skillet and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the pork from the skillet and set aside.
Add the sliced shallots to the skillet and cook until they are lightly browned and crispy, about 3 minutes.
Add the sliced carrots and potatoes to the skillet and cook until they are tender, about 5 minutes.
Return the pork to the skillet and stir to combine with the vegetables.
Season the mixture with salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, until the pork is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
Shock the cooked pork and vegetables in an ice bath to stop the cooking process.
Serve the skillet hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
